verdict.rationale: Terraform's first-party policy enforcement in HCP Terraform workspaces validates that Terraform plans comply with security rules and best practices. Custom policies can be written in Terraform policy, Sentinel, or OPA, and enforcement results can be viewed and overridden in the workspace UI, which implies runs are gated pending compliance. Policies can also be published and consumed via the Registry. missing for 10: explicit documentation of hard-blocking (mandatory) enforcement levels that stop apply, evidence that this works in the standalone CLI rather than only in HCP Terraform, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
